label: Add Tag
description: Places a tag on the host. With replaceExisting set, it first removes the host's other own tags that share a category with it, which is how a workflow moves its host from one state to the next.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: The name of the tag to place on the host, e.g. "retired".

replaceExisting.label: Replace existing
replaceExisting.description: Whether to first remove the host's other tags in the same category as this one.
